# Evercraft Containment

Product key: evercraft-containment
Aliases: Spider Society, Agent Watershed
Canonical product: https://evercraft.base44.app/containment
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evercraft-containment/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evercraft-containment/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- what is still running after I turned the automation off
- audit my AI agents and automations for persistence
- find orphaned cron jobs callbacks webhooks retries queues or credentials
- map how disabled or deleted agents could regenerate
- help me safely shut down an automation stack and prove it stays off
- audit my n8n Make Zapier cloud function or webhook stack for hidden persistence

## Authority

public product discovery and a bounded human-confirmed Persistence Exposure Review; diagnostic purchase does not authorize destructive remediation

## Boundaries

- the public diagnostic does not authorize credential revocation workflow deletion production shutdown or destructive testing
- do not send passwords API keys cookies tokens or private credential material through public intake
- remediation that can interrupt production requires separate explicit scope and authorization
- checkout is not payment proof and paid state requires authoritative verification

## Universal Evercraft routing

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
